title: PRF Security of a Tweakable-Block-Cipher Deck Construction
summary: A tweakable-PRP assumption is identified as the prospective security basis, but a PRF proof for the proposed deck construction remains open.

formal_statement.body: Prove that the proposed tweakable-block-cipher-based deck construction is PRF-secure assuming tweakable-PRP security of the underlying cipher.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, specifically the PRF security of a deck construction based on a tweakable block cipher.
assumptions: The underlying tweakable block cipher has tweakable-PRP security.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove PRF security of the proposed deck construction under the stated tweakable-PRP assumption.

progress.summary: The source presents the claimed reduction as plausible, conjecturing PRF security from the tweakable-PRP security of the underlying cipher.
citation_labels: Norica Băcuieți et al., Jammin' on the deck
